text: Nedbank Group's 2025 country-by-country reporting names Nedbank Zimbabwe Limited as its resident entity in Zimbabwe.
short: Nedbank Zimbabwe Limited is Nedbank Group's resident entity in Zimbabwe.

source.name: Nedbank Group, 2025 Governance Report (Individual country analysis, tax report)
source.quote: Name of resident entities Nedbank Zimbabwe Limited
source.note: From the 'Individual country analysis' panel for Zimbabwe in Nedbank Group's 2025 report suite (year ended 31 December 2025); the panel continues 'Nedbank Zimbabwe Limited offers a full range of commercial and consumer banking products and services'. The same group's 2025 Integrated Report (page 7, https://group.nedbank.co.za/content/dam/group/pdf/21_integrated-reports/2025/integrated-report/2025-integrated-report-nedbank.pdf, opened 2026-10-04) says: 'The group also currently operates in 5 countries in the Southern African Development Community (SADC) through subsidiaries and banks in Lesotho, Mozambique, Namibia, Eswatini and Zimbabwe'. The suite was distributed to shareholders in April 2026.
